_notes.guaranteed_field_semantics: TASK-COWORK-CATCHUP-9 (FR-10), re-scoped 2026-08-26 to state the VERIFIED-against-disk status, not the sprint's original design intent. `guaranteed:true` on a slot today enables 3 independently-shipped mechanisms: (1) parallel_group=chef mutex prioritization in cowork-chef-mutex.js; (2) inclusion in scripts/agents-flow/cowork-guaranteed-slot-firer.sh's OS-level launchd backstop (F1-LAUNCHD-COWORK-BACKSTOP, re-fires the CURRENT tick even with no live CLI session, but only while the host itself is awake — see 2026-07-07 durability brief); (3) inclusion in cowork-catchup-predicate.js's computeCatchupCandidates(), surfaced as the matcher's `catchup_raw` array (TASK-COWORK-CATCHUP-1/-2, DONE_VERIFIED). `guaranteed:true` does NOT (yet) mean the slot is delivered within a bounded catch-up window across a host-standby/multi-hour gap, and does NOT (yet) produce a structured miss record — `catchup_raw` is computed every tick and consumed by NOTHING: the planned Step 4.55 consumer `docs/agents/cowork-team/flow/catchup-check.md` was never built (its row TASK-COWORK-CATCHUP-3 was CANCELLED 2026-08-23), and the other 2 planned callers (`cowork-tick-preflight.sh` Step 6.5, `cowork-guaranteed-slot-firer.sh` task_list_held check) were never wired (TASK-COWORK-CATCHUP-4/-5, BLOCKED pending re-spec). See docs/architecture-briefs/2026-08-23-cowork-slot-durability-layer-inventory-and-miss-detection.md for the full current layer inventory and docs/architecture-briefs/2026-07-22-cowork-guaranteed-slot-catchup-design.md for the (partially-shipped) FR-1..10 design this note supersedes the optimistic reading of.
